2. Considering the allegations levelled against the applicant  that the applicant was found in possession of Gutka, committed the  road vehicular accident and recovery of the alleged Gutka on the spot  of incident, the Court is of the view that the applicant's further detain  is not essential.

Hence, the following order :
 ORDER  (i) Bail Application is allowed.
